source.message: fix(editor): bound Page Model child references

implementation.problem: Page Models already capped node count, but each node could carry an unbounded children array. Repeated or malformed persisted child references could make graph admission and publish traversal proportional to an oversized edge list.

policy.validTreeInvariant: A rooted tree with at most 1000 nodes has at most 999 parent-to-child edges.

behavior: A bounded aggregate reference counter rejects at the first over-limit array before graph traversal.
Node-count rejection runs first and is not made more expensive by scanning child arrays.
Schema and hierarchy validators fail closed without rewriting the rejected model.
Publish validation rejects before accessibility/authored-content graph walks.
Editor read, Save, Publish, rollback, page metadata writes, duplicate-source, and page creation reject malformed over-limit models; page-list serialization redacts their content.
Unpublish remains separately available; Save and Publish continue as distinct operations.
regressions: Exact aggregate limit accepted; first over-limit reference rejected.
A 100000-reference fixture is rejected without normalization or storage mutation.
Node-count guard takes precedence for an oversized-node fixture that also contains 100000 references.
Route integration verifies Editor GET/list, metadata PATCH, Save, Publish, rollback, source duplication and create all fail closed without page/revision/audit writes.
